title: potentilla thuringiaca var. buquoyana
intro: Potentilla thuringiaca var. buquoyana, commonly known as the Thuringian cinquefoil or buquoy's potentilla, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to Europe. Potentilla thuringiaca var. buquoyana is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits, contributing to its use in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Potentilla thuringiaca var. buquoyana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
